fare_rules.concessions: PMA fare policy (Metrobus card): Rs 20 single journey; Rs 25 for two journeys and Rs 30 for three (Rs 5 per integrated transfer). safar.fyi shows Rs 25. Effect of the Mar-2026 BRT fare increase on feeders unverified.
